title: Technical Consultant, AI Integration (Part-Time Contract)
description:
*****Please apply and contact me only through Upwork. Do not contact me on LinkedIn or send cold emails about this role. All hiring and contracting for this position will take place exclusively through Upwork.***** Technical Consultant, AI Integration (Part-Time Contract)

We're looking for an experienced technical consultant with strong AI integration experience and deep knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) within Claude Enterprise. Our engineers will handle implementation. We need someone to review the architecture, help resolve technical questions, and assess security and reliability as the project develops. The expected commitment is approximately 4–6 hours per week, at $45–$100 USD/hour. Any additional time for the initial review or launch will be agreed in advance. Applicants worldwide are welcome. Minimum Job Success Score: 91%.

The project
We're connecting Claude Enterprise to operational systems covering service tickets, device management and internal documentation through MCP connectors. The initial pilot is read-only, with potential to add further integrations and actions requiring human approval. The proposed architecture includes a cloud-hosted integration gateway, user authentication, access controls, sensitive-data filtering, audit logging, secrets management and controls to pause access.

What you'll do
- Review the proposed architecture and identify gaps, dependencies and technical decisions.
- Advise engineers on MCP server and tool design, custom connectors within Claude Enterprise, authentication and deployment.
- Review how AI retrieves information and requests actions, including tool permissions, sensitive-data exposure and human approval.
- Review critical designs and code involving access controls, logging and approval workflows.
- Help resolve complex integration issues during scheduled sessions.
- Join selected client discussions to explain technical tradeoffs.
- Assess pilot readiness and document risks and recommended next steps.

Our engineering team owns coding, testing, deployment and daily delivery. We'll agree review milestones and response expectations around the available hours.

What we're looking for
- Deep practical knowledge of MCP, including remote server architecture, tool definitions, authentication, authorization and troubleshooting.
- Hands-on experience building and deploying custom MCP integrations within Claude Enterprise.
- Strong experience with production AI applications, including tool use, context management, evaluation and failure handling.
- Understanding of AI-specific security risks, including prompt injection, sensitive-data disclosure and unauthorized tool execution.
- Senior engineering or architecture experience with production APIs and integrations.
- Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure, identity management and secrets management.
- Experience enforcing individual user permissions when integrations use shared service accounts.
- Ability to review code, give engineers practical guidance, and discuss architecture and security with client technical teams.

Experience with IT service management systems or device management platforms would be useful.

Engagement
Part-time contract, initially covering architecture review and pilot support, with potential to continue into later phases. Please share your availability, hourly rate and relevant experience. Include a Claude Enterprise MCP integration you personally worked on, your role, and how you handled authentication, permissions and testing.
